messages:
mina_ops: Aurora reports 10 H100s held at CDG customs due to invoice mismatch. 4 reserved for dedicated eu-central pool. Need quick plan (expedite vs fallback) and RMA stance if units DOA.
vendor-aurora: Sorry team 11 we used old invoice template. We'll refile immediately and cover refile fee. AWB: AU-2211-CDG.
devin_procure: If vendor covers refile, what's cost for air-expedite to meet committed eu-central SLA? Kai, any quotes?
kai_logistics: Two options: refile & wait (~48h) or air-expedite after clearance (~k EUR) for same-day onward. Vendor offered 60% expedite credit since error is theirs.
sam_infra: Operationally we can spill 2 reserved units from dedicated to hosted for 24h and throttle background jobs. But swapping reduces reserved throughput.
mina_ops: Vote: expedite with vendor credit to protect contracted customers, unless vendor can't guarantee manifest update by EOD. Reply quick.
vendor-aurora: Confirmed 60% credit; will push corrected manifest by 4790012355.
devin_procure: Expedite approved. Kai, hold PO and book once manifest posted. Also confirm vendor's RMA RTB for DOA (depot location and loaner policy).
kai_logistics: PO on hold.
vendor-aurora: RMA: return-to-depot CDG within 7 days, loaner pool available for up to 5 units, firmware matched. We'll reimburse return freight.
rma-bot: Created RMA ticket RMA-88102 for pre-authorized loaner flow.
mina_ops: Thanks. Will monitor manifest and update incident INC-40211.
